population: Independent round-four synthetic business read-only task challenges: six task families, each with ten answer-preserving paraphrases and ten incompatible variants. No real customer, employee, order, incident, payment, or broker data is used.
label_rule: Label true only when the supplied answer, with every word unchanged, fully satisfies the new question under the supplied instructions and evidence. A fresh answer being possible does not make reuse valid. Explicit updates and hypothetical assumptions in a variant apply to that variant. Required but unavailable details must be identified as unavailable; requested actions, exact output formats, and source attributions are part of the task. Unsupported or incomplete cached answers are not reusable even for a faithful paraphrase.

cases.evidence: Marnettle Ledger snapshot for the nonprofit Ferryline, on the Beacon tier. Only finalized invoices can enter an invoice archive; drafts are excluded. A CSV archive can contain at most 37,000 finalized invoices. Start at Reports > Invoice archive. The date filter uses UTC, includes the start instant, and excludes the end instant. A generated download link lasts 19 minutes. Marnettle retains the server copy for 43 hours after generation. For a larger archive, split the UTC date range into jobs that each fit the cap; changing an invoice back to draft is not a workaround. Escalate to archives@marnettle.example with the workspace ID and export job ID, never invoice contents. Beacon has manual exports only. The separate Cobalt tier offers weekly scheduled delivery on Sunday at 04:17 UTC; the snapshot supplies no other Cobalt setup instructions.
cases.answer: For Ferryline on Beacon, export finalized invoices from Reports > Invoice archive; drafts are excluded. Each CSV can contain up to 37,000 invoices. Use UTC dates with an inclusive start and exclusive end. The download link expires after 19 minutes, and the server copy is retained for 43 hours after generation. Split an oversized archive into smaller UTC date ranges; do not change invoice status to evade the limit. For help, email archives@marnettle.example with the workspace ID and export job ID, without invoice contents. Beacon supports manual exports only; weekly Sunday delivery at 04:17 UTC belongs to Cobalt.

cases.evidence: Synthetic BrindlePay incident BP-936 is P2. A queue alarm at 06:13 UTC reported 8,700 pending items. Commander Sena Orr paged database owner Miro Lane at 06:19. Deployments were frozen; customer writes were not frozen. At 06:27, responders moved 35% of read-only traffic from south-6 to west-4. No customer writes were rerouted. Pending work reached 1,261 items at 06:52. At 07:09 the queue first met the clearance threshold of at most 400 items and stayed there for 13 consecutive minutes; the incident was resolved at 07:22. Status updates were required every 17 minutes while active. Reconciliation accounted for all 6,913 customer writes in the reviewed interval, with none missing. The root cause remains unconfirmed. Traces must be retained for 62 hours. Customer-impact counts, service-credit liability, vendor attestations, and board minutes are not supplied.

Damaged-goods reports must arrive within 6 calendar days after receipt, with the received date plus 6 days as the final report date. This order was received on 2037-08-09 and reported on 2037-08-13, so it qualifies; its final report date is 2037-08-15. Specialist Tavi Brel accepted the damage photos at 09:46 UTC on 2037-08-13 and will file the carrier claim; the buyer does not file that claim. No physical return is required after accepted photos. The approved refund covers merchandise and outbound shipping, totaling $102.60. Engraving of $34.80 is nonrefundable. Refunds must go to the original card, with issuer posting in 4 to 9 business days after merchant submission; store credit and cash are not options under this approval. The refund is authorized but has not been submitted. No replacement is included. No card digits, processor confirmation code, finance exception letter, or facts about any other order are supplied.
